title: Travel Narratives with the Pretérito Indefinido

sections.content: Use the pretérito indefinido to recount completed events in a finished past journey. It is useful for saying what happened, where someone arrived and what they did during the trip: *llegamos*, viajaron, visitó, *volvieron*.

items.english: We arrived at the airport early.

items.spanish: El avión despegó a las ocho.
items.english: The plane took off at eight.
They returned to Hanoi on Sunday.

sections.content: Keep the time frame clear. Use ir a + infinitive for a plan, the indefinido for a completed past event, and the perfecto for a recent experience connected to the present.
